chapters.desc: Meet the cast and make the first choice.

rain_01.speaker: 旁白
rain_01.text: The rain has almost stopped when four messages arrive within the same minute.

phone_01.text: Still awake? I could use some company.

rain_02.speaker: 你
rain_02.text: Four conversations. Four possible directions. This small demo exists to show how routes are built.

choice.text: Meet 艾米 at the café

lx_01.speaker: 林夏
lx_01.text: You came. I wasn't sure you would.

sq_01.speaker: 苏晴
sq_01.text: You called me first? That's either brave or suspicious.

amy_01.speaker: 艾米
amy_01.text: I like people who answer directly. It saves time.

amy_02.speaker: 你
amy_02.text: Then I should probably stop rehearsing my answer.

gn_01.speaker: 顾宁
gn_01.text: This meeting is technically about work. Technically.

cross_01.speaker: 陈默
cross_01.text: You know this is going to become complicated, right?

cross_02.speaker: 你
cross_02.text: That's what the route graph is for.
